P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.goal: Raise the ground-truth ceiling, not the bar, and re-ask Gate 1.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.masks: the EXISTING 24 Stage-G demo masks in results/demo_mask_manifest.json (K=24, 68 demos/mask, manifest seed 11). NOT resampled.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.probe_battery: identical to Phase 1 Stage G: for each of the 9 clusters, its 3 probe tasks x 10 rollouts (270 episodes/model) + held-out L2 (plain) and the phase-masked transport/interaction losses on that cluster's 10 held-out demos.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.merged_outcomes_artifact: phase2/results/stage_G6_outcomes.parquet (Phase-1 seeds 401-402 merged with the 4 new seeds)
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.attribution: REUSED unchanged from results/influence_table.parquet (ensemble-averaged per-demo scores). No new attribution computed for P1.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.predicted_mask_score: sum of the attributor's per-demo score over the 68 demos in the mask (lds.mask_pred_score), attributor x functional x target.

ceiling_estimator.definition: 6-seed split-half reliability: over all 10 distinct 3-vs-3 seed splits of {401..406}, Spearman between the two half-mean outcome vectors across the 24 masks; average the 10 values (= reliability of a 3-seed mean); Spearman-Brown correct 3->6 as r6 = 2*r3/(1+r3).
ceiling_estimator.computed_per: outcome x target, on the SAME 24 masks the LDS is measured on (self-consistent; Phase-1's noise_ceilings.json used a different mask set and is NOT reused as the bar)

P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.SECONDARY_OUTCOME: logit_success (descriptive only; Phase 1 proved it unreliable at this grain)
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.PREREGISTERED_CRITERION: Attribution is USABLE at demo grain iff, for a focal target (C1 or C5), ANY attributor reaches rho >= 0.5 * (that target's measured 6-seed L2 ceiling) with one-sided p < 0.025 (Bonferroni-2 over the 2 focal targets).
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.predicted_score_functional_for_primary: plain (matched to the L2 outcome). transport/interaction reported descriptively.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.multiplicity_note: The criterion as specified takes the max over 3 attributors WITHOUT correcting for it, and applies Bonferroni-2 over the 2 focal targets. This is followed EXACTLY as written. A stricter Bonferroni-6 (2 targets x 3 attributors, alpha=0.05/6=0.00833) is ALSO reported as a robustness column, but the PASS/FAIL verdict is the criterion above.
P1_seed_ensembled_demo_grain_LDS.prediction_to_check: Spearman-Brown from Phase 1's 1-seed L2 reliability (~0.40) predicts a 6-seed ceiling ~= 0.80. Report predicted vs measured.

SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.PASS: Phase 1's Gate-1 failure was the noise floor: attribution carries usable demo-grain signal once ground truth is seed-ensembled.
SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.FAIL_at_high_ceiling: attribution is genuinely unfaithful at demo grain in this regime - a clean, strong null.

P2_per_task_transfer_sign_prediction.goal: Test whether attribution predicts WHICH tasks co-training helps and which it hurts, where the cluster mean cancels.

measured_margins.source: EXISTING Phase-1 Stage-B artifacts: runs/stage_B/{C1,C2,C5}_{target,cotrain}_s{101..105}/cluster_eval.json, which ALREADY store per_task_success (20 rollouts/task).
measured_margins.note: The brief budgeted <=11k episodes to re-evaluate 30 checkpoints IF per-task rollouts had not been saved. They WERE saved. Re-evaluation is therefore unnecessary and is NOT run; this is a budget saving, not a cut.
measured_margins.margin_definition: per task: mean over seeds 101-105 of (cotrain per_task_success - target-only per_task_success), in percentage points, exact rational arithmetic.

per_task_probe_sets.size: 5 held-out demos per task, for each of the 27 tasks
per_task_probe_sets.selection_rule: DETERMINISTIC: the 5 highest-indexed demos of each task, i.e. demo_45, demo_46, demo_47, demo_48, demo_49 (every LIBERO task has 50 demos).
disjointness_guaranteed_against: the 135-demo training corpus (all 9 clusters' train pools) - which only ever uses demo_0/demo_1/demo_2
all 9 clusters' 10-demo held-out sets - which only ever use demo_1/demo_2
the Stage-C Q=50 and Q=150 / P3 quantity ladders (which fill from the LOW demo indices upward)
per_task_probe_sets.DISCLOSED_SPEC_INTERPRETATION: The brief asks for probe demos 'NEVER used in any Phase-1 training pool'. Taken to include Stage-C's Q=490 pool, this is UNSATISFIABLE: Q=490 is by construction every libero_goal demo except C1's 10 held-out, so C1 would have zero eligible probe demos. 'Training pool' is therefore scoped to the pools of the models whose gradients define the attribution (the 135-demo corpus: Stages B/E/F/G) plus every held-out set. Stage-C's Q=490 models are not used anywhere in P2. This interpretation is fixed HERE, before running, and the exact demo lists are written to phase2/results/per_task_probes.json with the disjointness assertions machine-checked.

attribution.what: per-demo attribution of all 135 training demos toward EACH of the 27 tasks' L2 (plain) functional
attribution.models: the Stage-E 10-member ensemble (primary) and the Stage-B co-train checkpoints (secondary, reported separately)

predicted_benefit.PRIMARY: sum of OUTSIDER demo attributions toward that task (outsider = a demo whose cluster != the task's cluster)

PREREGISTERED_TEST.PRIMARY: Spearman between predicted benefit and measured per-task margin, POOLED across all 27 tasks; one-sided alpha = 0.05 (H1: rho > 0). Critical rho ~ 0.32 at n=27.
PREREGISTERED_TEST.SECONDARY: the same Spearman within each of C1 / C5 / C2 separately (n = 10 / 7 / 10; low power, descriptive)
PREREGISTERED_TEST.ALSO: sign-agreement rate (does attribution get help-vs-hurt right?) over the 27 tasks, exact two-sided binomial test against p=0.5
PREREGISTERED_TEST.attributor_multiplicity: the primary test is run for each of the 3 attributors; the headline verdict uses the PRIMARY estimator declared here = IF on the Stage-E ensemble. The other two are reported as robustness.

P3_regime_boundary.goal: Locate the data scale at which closed-loop ground truth and demo-level attribution become reliable.
P3_regime_boundary.Q_ladder: DETERMINISTIC and NESTED, reusing Phase-1 stage_c.goal_demo_ladder() exactly: Q=15 IS C1's training pool; Q=50 and Q=150 extend it by round-robin over tasks (lowest demo index first), skipping C1's 10 held-out demos. Q15 subset Q50 subset Q150.

masks_per_Q.balance: each demo appears in as close to K*alpha = 7.2 masks as balance allows (min/max inclusion recorded and asserted)

full_Q_ensemble.purpose: the attribution ensemble AT THAT SCALE (5 models per Q)

outcomes_per_model.held_out_L2: C1's 10 held-out demos (plain / transport / interaction losses)
outcomes_per_model.success: the FULL Goal suite: 10 tasks x 20 rollouts = 200 episodes/model

per_Q_statistics.ceiling: 4-seed split-half: all 3 disjoint 2-vs-2 seed pairings; Spearman between pair-mean outcome vectors over the 12 masks; average (= reliability of a 2-seed mean). Spearman-Brown 2->4 also reported. Computed for BOTH neg_plain_loss and logit_success.
per_Q_statistics.LDS: Spearman(predicted mask score, 4-seed-mean outcome) over the 12 masks, per attributor, with the attribution computed from that Q's OWN 5 full-Q models

PREREGISTERED_TEST.statistic_i: monotone INCREASE across Q of the SUCCESS-outcome ceiling. Page's trend test, blocks = the 3 disjoint 2-vs-2 seed pairings, treatments = Q in {15,50,150} (k=3, n=3), one-sided alpha = 0.05, H1: ceiling(15) <= ceiling(50) <= ceiling(150) with at least one strict.
PREREGISTERED_TEST.statistic_ii: monotone INCREASE across Q of the best LDS/ceiling ratio. Page's trend test, blocks = the 3 attributors {IF, TRAK, TracIn}, treatments = Q (k=3, n=3), one-sided alpha = 0.05.
PREREGISTERED_TEST.power_disclosure: With k=3, n=3 Page's L attains a minimum one-sided p of ~0.0079, so alpha=0.05 is reachable, but power is LOW. Bootstrap CIs over masks are reported alongside and the trend tests are NOT the only evidence presented; the figure carries the result.
PREREGISTERED_TEST.also_reported: Spearman of each statistic vs Q as a secondary trend summary.

P3_regime_boundary.deliverable: phase2/figures/regime_boundary.png - ceiling vs Q and LDS vs Q with per-Q bootstrap CIs

INTERPRETATION.both_rise: prescription: a minimum data scale exists below which demo-level attribution and closed-loop ground truth are untrustworthy.
INTERPRETATION.flat: the Phase-1 negative result generalizes beyond the 15-demo regime.

budget_ledger.per_stage_alert_rule: time the first 3 retrains of each kind; if the projected stage cost exceeds 1.5x its ledger line, write phase2/BUDGET_ALERT.md and PAUSE that stage.

cut_policy: Never cut silently. Every cut is logged in phase2/STATUS.md and reported in PHASE2_REPORT.md.

integrity_rules.no_fabrication: every reported number is read from an artifact file written by an actual run; failed runs are reported as failed; SYNTHETIC tests are labelled and never mixed with results.
integrity_rules.no_post_hoc_changes: zero post-hoc criterion or functional changes. If an instrument defect is found, STOP and document in phase2/PHASE2_DEFECT.md before touching anything.
